items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A pill button whose letters roll up from the middle on hover, with a lift and a springy press.

items.name: magnetic
items.title: Magnetic
items.description: Pulls what it wraps toward the mouse, then springs back with an elastic overshoot.

items.name: scroll-reveal
items.title: Scroll reveal
items.description: Text that fills in word by word as you scroll it into view.

items.name: parallax-columns
items.title: Parallax columns
items.description: Three columns that scroll at different speeds.

items.name: path-carousel
items.title: Path carousel
items.description: Items ride a curved path, the centre one biggest; scroll, swipe or use the arrows to rotate.

items.name: notch
items.title: Notch
items.description: A tab that hangs from the top edge with inverse-rounded shoulders, dropping in once on mount.

items.name: hero-reveal
items.title: Hero reveal
items.description: A hero whose photo frame opens along the y-axis, then the headline blurs up and the action springs in.

items.name: layered-menu
items.title: Layered menu
items.description: A burger that opens a full-frame menu of four coloured panels dropping in turn.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: An on/off switch whose knob stretches as it travels, driven by one spring.

items.name: counter
items.title: Counter
items.description: A number that rolls digit by digit to its value.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs with a pill that glides under the active label.
